Name: Keybind Sheet
Author: bao7221
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
Keybind Sheet shows every loaded mod's keybindings in one vanilla-style in-game sheet.

Press K (configurable) or click the K tab on the right edge to open it. It reads every mod's config file plus all 27 vanilla keybindings and displays them in five columns: Key / Mod / Action / Type / Note. Conflicts are colour-coded: red for two mods sharing a key, blue for a mod-vs-vanilla collision, orange for a combination being covered by another mod.
[line]

快捷键表（Keybind Sheet）：一页查看所有已加载模组的快捷键，原版羊皮纸风格。

按 K（可改键）或点屏幕右侧的 K 标签打开。自动读取所有模组的配置文件和游戏本体 27 个键位，按「按键 / 模组 / 功能 / 类型 / 备注」五列展示。冲突会标色：红色是两个以上模组抢同一个键，蓝色是模组键和本体键冲突，橙色是组合键被遮蔽。
[line]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI 4.x for Stardew Valley 1.6.
2. Download and unzip this mod.
3. Copy the "KeybindSheet" folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54867/54867-1793453970-647030014.png[/img]
[line]

1. 安装 SMAPI 4.x（星露谷 1.6）。
2. 下载并解压本模组。
3. 把 KeybindSheet 文件夹放进 星露谷/Mods。
4. 通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。
[line]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- Five-column sheet: Key / Mod / Action / Type / Note
- Conflict detection: mod-vs-mod (red), mod-vs-vanilla (blue), combination shadowing (orange)
- Reads mod config files and all 27 vanilla keybindings
- Search by mod, action, note, key or mod ID; filter conflicts / suspected keys / by mod / by key
- Sort by key or mod; automatic rescan when the sheet opens
- Editable notes (click a note cell, Enter to save)
- Optional runtime translation: DeepL, Google, OpenAI or DeepSeek, cached locally
- UI language: 12 languages
- Export CSV, export a catalog snapshot, auto-fill unknown catalog entries
- Gamepad navigation and GMCM settings page
[line]

- 五列总表：按键 / 模组 / 功能 / 类型 / 备注
- 冲突检测：模组互撞（红）、撞本体（蓝）、组合键遮蔽（橙）
- 读取模组配置文件 + 游戏本体 27 个键位
- 支持按模组/功能/备注/按键/Mod ID 搜索，筛选只看冲突、疑似键、按模组、按按键
- 按按键或模组排序；打开面板时自动重扫
- 备注可在游戏内直接编辑（点备注格，Enter 保存）
- 可选运行时翻译：DeepL / Google / OpenAI / DeepSeek，结果本地缓存
- 界面语言 12 种
- 支持导出 CSV、导出词条包、自动补全未收录词条
- 支持手柄操作，支持 GMCM 设置页

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
- Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu
- Optional: an IME fix mod (e.g. InputMethodFix) for Chinese text input
- Optional: your own API key for runtime translation
[line]

- 星露谷 1.6
- SMAPI 4.0.0 或更高
- 可选：Generic Mod Config Menu（游戏内设置页）
- 可选：输入法修复类模组（如 InputMethodFix），用于中文输入
- 可选：自己的 API Key（仅在开启运行时翻译时需要）
[line]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Built with SMAPI by Pathoschild and contributors. Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and to the mod authors whose configs made the catalog examples possible.

[line]

基于 SMAPI（作者 Pathoschild 及贡献者）开发。感谢星露谷模组社区，也感谢那些配置文件为词条示例提供参考的模组作者。
[line]

[b][size=4]Known issues[/size][/b]
- Only config files inside the mod folder are readable; per-save configs and GMCM internal state cannot be read.
- Fields without a catalog entry show the raw field name; runtime translation can fill them.
- Hold-type modifiers only count as conflicts when combined with a pressed key.
- UI language switching depends on the current game font; unsupported scripts fall back to English.
- Chinese input requires an IME fix mod.
[line]

- 只能读取模组目录内的配置文件；每存档配置、GMCM 内部状态读不到。
- 没有词条的字段会显示原始字段名，可开启运行时翻译补全。
- 按住型修饰键只有与“按下”型键同时存在时才计为冲突。
- 界面语言切换受当前游戏字体限制，缺字形时会回退英文。
- 中文输入需要输入法修复类模组。
